paper_title: MMRA A Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Granularity and Multi-Image   Relational Association Capabilities in Large Visual Language Models
caption: The number and ratio of each subtask in our MMRA benchmark. The integers in the graph represent the number of samples in each task, while the percentages in parentheses indicate the proportion of each task in the entire benchmark.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the number of samples and the relative proportion of each subtask within the MMRA benchmark. The chart is divided into 11 slices, which appear visually ordered by descending size proceeding in a counter-clockwise direction starting from the top left. There is no separate legend; instead, bolded text labels are positioned directly on or adjacent to the outer edge of each corresponding slice, displaying the category name followed by the integer count and the percentage enclosed in parentheses. None of the segments are exploded, offset, or visually emphasized beyond the bold text. The largest slice, "ObservationAngle," is colored light teal and accounts for 126 samples (12.28%). Continuing counter-clockwise, the subsequent slices are "SimilarMaterial" in orange at 106 (10.33%), "SubEvent" in light red at 100 (9.74%), "UsageSimilarity" in coral at 100 (9.65%), "Environment" in dark teal at 90 (8.77%), "Layout" in pale yellow at 90 (8.77%), "AppearanceSimilarity" in pale green at 90 (8.77%), "SimilarEvent" in light blue at 90 (8.77%), "MentalitySimilarity" in light cyan at 89 (8.67%), "RelativePosition" in light gray at 81 (7.90%), and finally the smallest slice, "NearSameEntity," in dark gray at 63 (6.34%).
